text:
Tiama skim over the waves in great flying shoals with their elongated mouths extended over the water as they weave in and out of the 
exposed coral structures of the Strands, snatching the many insects that flit about the undulating colorful fronds. At three to four feet 
long, these creatures fall prey to many predators of both land and sea, surviving only by the coordinated quick movements of their 
shoal and always alert, orb-like eyes that dart back and forth, looking for the slightest sign of danger. When threatened and escape is 
no longer an option, the shoal will turn on the aggressor like a storm of razor sharp fi ns, leaving any would-be-predator bleeding and 
sinking beneath the waves as the shoal flies past.

Razored Fins Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in 
the shoal’s space. Hit: 17 (4d6+3) Slashing damage, or 10 (2d6+3) 
Slashing damage if the shoal has half of its Hit Points or fewer. 
With the use of its large ocular sockets and 
ability for disconjugate eye movement, the 
fish is capable of zoning in on small prey, all 
the while watching for incoming predators 
from both below and above the tide
Large pectoral fins allow the tiama to 
soar over the water for long periods 
of time. Stiff edged spines deter aerial 
predators from plucking the gliding 
fish from above the waves 
Highly sensitive feelers aid the tiama in 
sensing air currents and atmospheric pressure 
to guide the shoal to warm air pockets where 
ocean-borne insects tend to swarm
Encountering Rarely ever seen alone, the tiama lives exclusively 
in large groups and act as one. Fishing for tiama can be 
diffi cult as they can seamlessly switch between swimming and 
gliding over the waves with ease. Once the swarm feels overly 
threatened, the shoal will flee in a manner requiring the most 
effort by the pursuer.
Skills Acrobatics +5, Perception +2
Resistances Bludgeoning, Piercing
Immunities Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Prone, 
Restrained, Stunned

Swarming Shoal Th e shoal can occupy another creature’s space 
and vice versa, and the shoal can move through any opening large 
enough for a Medium creature. Th e shoal cannot regain Hit Points 
or gain temporary Hit Points.
Disperse When the tiama shoal takes damage from an attack, 
it can momentarily scatter into individual fi sh as a Reaction, 
reducing the damage taken by half. Th e shoal of tiama then 
immediately reassemble.
Slashing Flight Th e shoal can fly through a target creature’s 
space, dealing 7 (2d6) Slashing damage to the target creature 
when it enters its space for the fi rst time or when the creature 
starts its turn in the tiama shoal's space.
Tidal Glide If the shoal moves in a non-straight line or under 30 
ft. during its movement, it loses its flying speed and can only 
move by swimming until the end of its turn.
Aggressive Instinct When the tiama shoal is engaged in combat and 
Bloodied, they begin to coordinate their efforts in a frenzy.
